errors.text_span: докато при EC‑15 най-високите положителни стълбове са около средата на периода (приблизително около 3,5–3,7%)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the highest positive bars for the EC-15 series are in the middle of the period with values of ~3.5-3.7%. The actual highest bar for the EC-15 series is in the year 2000 with a value of approximately 4.6%.
